name: Bonsai
description:
Bonsai is where independent consultants and small service businesses run client work: CRM, deals, projects, tasks, time tracking, and invoices in one place.

The Bonsai MCP server connects your account to Claude. Ask where work stands, keep clients and projects current, and run the whole business from one conversation.

Key features:
- Ask about your business - Your tasks for today, where a deal stands, what's outstanding, or a project summary you can send a client.
- Keep your CRM current - Add contacts and companies, log activity, and move deals through your pipeline.
- Turn won work into a project - A closed deal becomes a project with tasks, owners, and due dates, ready to start.
- Track time and bill for it - Log hours against a project, then draft the invoice when the work is done.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bonsai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bonsai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hellobonsai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bonsai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonsai lists 39 MCP tools, including create_comment, create_company, create_contact, create_deal, create_invoice, create_invoice_item, create_note, create_note_link, create_project, create_task, create_time_entry, and destroy_invoice_item.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bonsai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bonsai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Bonsai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bonsai is developed by Bonsai by Zoom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
